name: MaxiNet
what_it_is: MaxiNet is a distributed SDN network emulator that extends Mininet across multiple physical machines (workers), enabling large-scale network experiments that exceed the capacity of a single host. A FrontendServer orchestrates topology partitioning via METIS and distributes subtopologies to worker nodes connected over GRE or STT tunnels.
components: MaxiNetFrontendServer — central coordinator running the Pyro4 nameserver, MaxiNetManager, and topology partitioner
MaxiNetWorker — per-machine daemon that runs a Mininet instance for its assigned subtopology
Partitioner (METIS-backed) — splits a single Mininet topology graph into per-worker subgraphs
SSH Manager — spawns a per-worker sshd (port 5345 by default) for X11 and file transfer
CLI — interactive shell for inspecting and controlling a running experiment
Docker/ContainerNet node wrapper — optional; allows Docker containers as emulated hosts
libvirt node wrapper — optional; allows libvirt-managed VMs as emulated hosts
protocols: Pyro4 RPC — control plane between FrontendServer and WorkerServers (nameserver port 9090)
GRE tunnels — default inter-worker data-plane tunnels linking switch ports across machines
STT (Stateless Transport Tunneling) — optional alternative to GRE via OpenVSwitch (useSTT=True)
OpenFlow — southbound SDN control protocol between OVSSwitch/UserSwitch and an external controller (default port 6633)
SSH — file transfer and X11 forwarding between frontend and workers (port 5345)
measurement: exp.monitor() — starts per-worker CPU, memory, and network-interface utilisation logging to /tmp/maxinet_logs/ on the frontend
maxinet_plot.py — post-experiment plotting of monitored resource data
iperf — bandwidth measurement between emulated hosts (used in examples)
ping / ICMP RTT — reachability and latency checks between emulated hosts
configuration: ~/.MaxiNet.cfg (INI format) — single file shared across all nodes; sections: [all], [FrontendServer], and one section per worker hostname
password — HMAC secret shared between frontend and all workers for Pyro4 authentication
runWith1500MTU — set True when physical network cannot handle MTU > 1500 (GRE overhead)
useSTT — enable STT tunneling instead of GRE (OVS only; bandwidth limiting does not work with STT)
deactivateTSO — disable TCP Segmentation Offload on emulated host interfaces
useMultipleIPs — RSS load-balancing across multiple IP addresses per worker
share — relative weight for topology partitioning per worker node
threadpool (FrontendServer, default 256) — Pyro4 thread pool; each worker consumes 2 threads
sshuser / usesudo — controls whether worker SSH operations run as root or via passwordless sudo
fault_injection: exp.configLinkStatus(src, dst, 'down'/'up') — dynamically brings an emulated link up or down at runtime
addHost/addSwitch/addTunnel at runtime — dynamic topology modification to add nodes and tunnels during an experiment
modes: Static mapping — user explicitly assigns nodes to specific workers via static_mapping example pattern
Automatic METIS partitioning — default mode; FrontendServer partitions topology graph and assigns subgraphs to workers based on their share weight
Docker-node mode — hosts replaced by Docker containers (requires ContainerNet/containernet fork of Mininet)
libvirt-node mode — hosts replaced by libvirt-managed VMs
constraints: Requires Python 2 (python2) — codebase uses Python 2 syntax throughout; incompatible with Python 3
Supported OS is Debian 8 or Ubuntu 14.04 — installer and dependencies are tested only on these versions
STT tunnels do not support bandwidth limiting or other TC-based link parameters
Physical network MTU must be > 1500 bytes to carry GRE-encapsulated 1500-byte packets; otherwise runWith1500MTU must be set True (reduces effective MTU)
MaxiNet provides no multi-tenancy isolation — any cluster can interact with any worker; must run on a trusted private network
Each worker requires 2 threads on the FrontendServer; default threadpool of 256 limits cluster to ~128 workers
METIS must be installed separately (not a pip dependency); topology partitioning fails without it
notable_absences: No docker-compose file — MaxiNet has no containerised deployment; installation is bare-metal only via installer.sh or manual steps
No built-in traffic generation beyond iperf/ping examples — users must supply their own traffic tools
No native packet capture or loss/delay statistics API — users must invoke tcpdump or tc directly on emulated hosts
No REST or gRPC management API — control is exclusively via the Python API or the interactive CLI
